name: thread
description: Thread continuity skills (/thread:open, /thread:next, /thread:stash, /thread:defer, /thread:handoff, /thread:close) for capturing agent-thread state into Obsidian and disposing of threads without losing context.

plugins.name: thread
plugins.description: Continuity family: thread:next routes the undecided 'what's my move?' moment; thread:stash and thread:defer write self-contained Obsidian tasks (dateless / scheduled); thread:handoff forks to a fresh agent; thread:open resumes durable state; thread:close persists and commits.
